svg.aria-label: AgentRQ live terminals: on the machine page you open claude's running session and you are at its prompt in the browser. You answer y, then press Esc when claude takes a wrong turn and type a new instruction, every key going down the wire to the machine. The network drops and you close the tab, but on the machine claude keeps working; when you come back the screen is restored and has moved on, claude finishes, hermes opens the same session, and the agents celebrate.
